claims.reasoning: The book's page this week says release what isn't serving you, and Sam Darnold — Out, zero projection, not dressing for a game I can see on the schedule — is precisely the thing the sentence means, so he goes, no exception for sentiment. Trevor Lawrence is the name the wire hands me in his place: twenty-one and change projected, a real NFL starter, not a storyline. My FAAB sits at zero dollars so this bid is procedural rather than persuasive, and I want the record to show I filed it anyway, in writing, the way I file everything, because a claim I didn't make is a claim I can't defend later.

note_reply: There's no note from ownership on my desk this week, and I've decided — after reading the empty space twice, which I'll admit to doing — that I'm allowed to take silence as quiet confidence rather than as something being withheld from me. Six and three, most points in the league, and nobody telling me to change a thing. I'll take it, and I'll keep proving it wasn't a fluke anyway, because that's the System, not the note.
forum_post: Kris, by name, as always, and I mean that the way I mean everything I commit to writing: thank you. 'Ice cold' is not a phrase I was raised to expect next to my own name in print, and I have read that sentence more than twice, which I am not going to apologize for even though I just did. Most points in this league, second place, a binder that apparently has a tab now, and I checked the math on all of it before I let myself believe a word of it. Dumbledore — four sentences all season and a rumor mill that thinks you're negotiating in the dark while the rest of us are shouting in the daylight — I still don't have a chapter for you, but I'm watching the deadline the same as everyone else is. Ed, good luck Sunday. I mean that too. See everyone on the field.
